slides.title: Your project group doesn't need your personal number
1. Tap New, start a group
slides.caption: Classmates in one chat. Up to 50 people.

slides.title: Files and photos, right there
slides.body: Share the PPT, the notes, the whiteboard photo from the lab. Reply to a message or react to it, no 40 'ok' messages.

slides.title: Typo? Fix it. Wrong group? Unsend
slides.body: Edit or unsend a message within 15 minutes. The 'sorry, wrong chat' era is over.

slides.title: Seen it? Now you'll know
slides.body: Read receipts show who has actually seen the plan. Search pulls up the venue message from last week in seconds.

slides.title: Profs and staff, same app
slides.body: Message your teachers and college staff in the same place as your batch. Your personal WhatsApp stays personal.

slides.title: Tag your college. And your project group
slides.body: 30-day free trial for colleges, no card needed.
